name: B01-core-only
scope: Prewritten clear + 32 clipped rectangles; synchronous C protocol validation and raster. Samples are elapsed/200 for a batch of 200 frames, not individual frame latency. Excludes recording, game logic, palette expansion, GPU, browser, network and audio.
executionNotes: Exploratory local run. Browser validation and builds ran concurrently; not an isolated performance acceptance result. No thermal/battery instrumentation.
